description: Unique name
Name of bus attached to winding 0 (typically high voltage).
Name of bus attached to winding 1 (typically medium voltage).
Name of bus attached to winding 2 (typically low voltage).

Name of 3-winding transformer standard type. If this is not an empty string "", the impedance parameters are taken from the standard type. This will override any values set in `r01`, `x01`, `r12`, `x12`, `r02`, `x02`, `g`, `b`, `s_nom0`, `s_nom1`, `s_nom2`, `tap_ratio`, `tap_side`, `phase_shift1` and `phase_shift2`. If the string is empty, values manually provided are taken.
Model used for the admittance matrix of the three 2-winding legs of the star equivalent; can be "t" or "pi"; defaults to "t" following physics and DIgSILENT PowerFactory
Rated apparent power of winding 0. Also the base power for the per unit impedances `r01`, `x01`, `r12`, `x12`, `r02`, `x02`, `g` and `b`. Ignored if type defined.
Rated apparent power of winding 1. Ignored if type defined.
Rated apparent power of winding 2. Ignored if type defined.
Series resistance between windings 0 and 1 measured with winding 2 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Series reactance between windings 0 and 1 measured with winding 2 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Series resistance between windings 1 and 2 measured with winding 0 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Series reactance between windings 1 and 2 measured with winding 0 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Series resistance between windings 0 and 2 measured with winding 1 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Series reactance between windings 0 and 2 measured with winding 1 open (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power). Ignored if type defined.
Magnetising shunt conductivity (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power), placed on the winding 0 leg of the star equivalent. Ignored if type defined.
Magnetising shunt susceptance (per unit, using `s_nom0` as base power), placed on the winding 0 leg of the star equivalent. Ignored if type defined.
Ratio of per unit voltages at the winding given by `tap_side`. Ignored if type defined.
Winding at which the tap changer is modelled (must be 0, 1 or 2, defaults to 0). Ignored if type defined.
If the transformer has a `type`, the absolute tap position on the same scale as `tap_min`/`tap_neutral`/`tap_max`. The nominal ratio (`tap_ratio` = 1) is obtained when `tap_position == tap_neutral`.
Voltage phase angle shift of winding 1 relative to winding 0. Same sign convention as `Transformer.phase_shift`. Ignored if type defined.
Voltage phase angle shift of winding 2 relative to winding 0. Same sign convention as `Transformer.phase_shift`. Ignored if type defined.
Switch to allow the transformer to be extended in optimisation as one unit, i.e. the ratings of all windings scale together in the ratio `s_nom0`:`s_nom1`:`s_nom2`.
If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the minimum value of `s_nom0_opt` (rating of winding 0).
If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the maximum value of `s_nom0_opt` (rating of winding 0).
If `s_nom_extendable=True`, set the value of `s_nom0_opt` (rating of winding 0).
Modular unit size of the expansion of winding 0. Introduces integer variables.
Fixed period costs of extending `s_nom0` by 1 MVA, including the corresponding extension of windings 1 and 2 (e.g. annuitized investment costs). Used directly unless `overnight_cost` is specified.
Overnight (upfront) investment cost per MVA of `s_nom0`. If specified, PyPSA calculates annuity using `discount_rate` and `lifetime`. Takes precedence over `capital_cost`.
Discount rate for annuity calculation when using `overnight_cost`. Supports 0% rate (simple depreciation).
Fixed period operation and maintenance costs per MVA of `s_nom0`, added to annuitized investment cost.
Build year of the transformer.
Lifetime of the transformer.
Whether to consider the component in the star equivalent created by `n.c.transformers3w.expand()`. Inactive 3-winding transformers create inactive legs.
Name of the auxiliary star bus created by `n.c.transformers3w.expand()`. Do not set by hand.
Optimised rating of winding 0.
Optimised rating of winding 1.
Optimised rating of winding 2.
Active power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`).
Reactive power at `bus0` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus0`).
Active power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`).
Reactive power at `bus1` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus1`).
Active power at `bus2` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus2`).
Reactive power at `bus2` (positive if branch is withdrawing power from `bus2`).
